naming: target domain names; map to existing schema before DDL

type_rules.timestamps: timestamptz UTC; IANA timezone for business calendars
type_rules.money: bigint minor EUR MVP; API safe integer ±9007199254740991; nonnegative except explicit signed reporting deltas
type_rules.scope: company_id/entity_id refers to legal seller unless explicitly operator; never interchangeable with user_id

tables.name: users
invariants: Do not duplicate provider passwords; soft disable does not delete financial contracts
tables.existing_mapping: Supabase auth.users; profiles is a separate private/public projection

tables.name: legal_entities
invariants: Operator is explicit; no name-based special case; tax IDs private
tables.existing_mapping: companies + company_legal_identities + company_legal_identifiers; preserve IDs

tables.name: memberships
invariants: Only authorized company context; staff roles separate; membership revocation invalidates access
tables.existing_mapping: company_members + company_member_roles; platform user_roles remains distinct

tables.name: seller_applications
invariants: Self-review denied; review reason/event immutable; approval does not mean PSP eligible
tables.existing_mapping: seller_applications + seller_application_events

tables.name: stores
invariants: Only approved public fields exposed; separate private return/KYB information
tables.existing_mapping: merchant_stores + merchant_store_public_profiles

tables.name: products

fields.title: localized text
fields.safety_data: manufacturer, EU responsible person, warnings, evidence refs

keys: GTIN uniqueness on canonical normalized identifier when validated
invariants: Do not merge solely on EAN; distinguish variants/pack sizes; duplicate suggestions require confidence/evidence/reviewer
tables.existing_mapping: catalog_products; legacy products requires explicit cutover

tables.name: seller_skus
invariants: Shared product does not share seller stock/costs
tables.existing_mapping: catalog_skus; check whether existing catalog is tenant-scoped before central mapping

tables.name: offers
invariants: Publication requires seller/PSP/tax/safety/shipping gates; no application-provided seller_id override
tables.existing_mapping: catalog_offers + channel_listings + borvat_direct_listing_publications; reconcile semantics

tables.name: offer_versions
invariants: Immutable once quoted; integer totals bounded to JS safe integer
tables.existing_mapping: merchant_store_offer_prices + version mapping

tables.name: carts
invariants: Buyer-only; cart not quote or reservation
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: cart_lines
invariants: Server validates upper bounds; no client total
tables.existing_mapping: legacy cart_items product_id must migrate to offer_id

tables.name: quotes
invariants: Server-authoritative; address hash and prices bind quote; scope one seller MVP
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: checkout_attempts
invariants: Same key+different body=409; provider timeout reconciles before retry; no DB lock during network call
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: orders
invariants: No client INSERT; financial/payment/order states separate; no cascade deletion with auth user
tables.existing_mapping: new canonical order root; legacy orders must be isolated

tables.name: seller_orders
invariants: One root supports later multiple sellers; seller reads own slice only
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: order_lines
invariants: Immutable price/tax/commission; shipped+cancelled quantities never exceed ordered; returns never exceed delivered eligible quantity
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: reservations
invariants: Atomic availability check; source Warehouse authoritative; expiry vs capture reconciled
tables.existing_mapping: inventory_reservation_headers/lines/allocations behind adapter

tables.name: provider_accounts
invariants: No bank secrets; only provider evidence changes capability; test/live never mix
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: payments
invariants: One successful payable obligation per order; amount/currency/account correlated; browser cannot mark paid
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: payment_allocations

fields.discount_minor: bigint >=0 allocated discount net amount; tax recalculated on discounted line

invariants: Amounts reconcile payment gross; allocation rounding deterministic; unknown PSP fee not zero
goods_minor and shipping_minor are net; gross allocation = goods_net + shipping_net + tax - allocated discount; clarify tax categories per line before DDL
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: shipments
invariants: Separate shipment_lines(line_id,quantity); sum shipped bounded by ordered; carrier evidence for delivery
tables.existing_mapping: channel_shipments is channel-specific; do not pretend BORVAT shipment canonical yet

tables.name: returns
invariants: Separate return_lines(order_line_id,quantity,disposition); buyer ownership checked; quarantine before restock
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: refunds
invariants: Sum pending+succeeded <= captured minus prior confirmed refunds; serialized lock; refund_lines allocate item/tax/shipping/commission credit
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: commission_rule_versions
keys: No overlapping effective approved rule for same scope+precedence
invariants: Explicit precedence seller/category/platform; snapshot rule at checkout; commercial rate awaits owner decision
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: finance_entries
invariants: Append-only; reversals new batches; operational mirror not accounting source of truth or spendable wallet
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: statements
invariants: Statement_lines link immutable finance entries; no unexplained variance at closure; correction creates revision not overwrite
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: payout_observations
invariants: PSP payout != platform custody != bank receipt; no ordinary API to force paid
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: accounting_exports
invariants: Invoice number assigned by accounting; durable retry/DLQ; e-Boekhouden remains read-only
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: support_cases
invariants: Private messages with scoped attachments; risk findings separate from public seller reputation
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: reviews
invariants: Verified purchase derived server-side; moderation reasons/events retained; no self-generated scores
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: documents
invariants: No public URLs; purpose-based access and expiring links; no PII document bytes in events
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: audit_events
invariants: Write in command transaction; denied attempts logged securely; no credential/identity document content
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: outbox
invariants: Transactional append; lease and claim token protect concurrent workers; at-least-once delivery
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: inbox
invariants: Webhook auth before accept; durable save before 2xx; dedup+business-effect uniqueness; conflicting payload quarantined
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

tables.name: idempotency_records
invariants: Concurrent replay returns same resource; different hash returns 409; financial external IDs retained beyond transient response-cache TTL
tables.existing_mapping: new domain object; reconcile existing schema in C0

implementation_requirements: Expand described child tables into explicit DDL with composite ownership FKs before C2/C3; no unvalidated JSON as substitute for money/quantity constraints
Tenant RLS+least privileges and trusted RPC/API boundaries; public catalog projection strips private data
Foreign key delete RESTRICT for orders/finance, retention-aware pseudonymization for users; no auth-user cascade deleting financial records
Index scope+status+created_at on transactional tables; unique external IDs scoped to provider account and mode
Use DB transactions with consistent lock order: order, payment, refund allocation, reservation; Warehouse remote effects via outbox saga
Do not run historical fixture-purge migrations against production or blindly replay data-dependent assertions
Financial totals, quantity caps and refund cumulative bounds require locks/constraint triggers or serialized command procedures; CHECK alone cannot enforce cross-row sums
